question: ‘Nupa’ dance is associated with which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nupa Dance** __

 __
 
• **​**The **Manipuri **form of **dance** and **music** has spawned **Nupa Pala** (also known as Kartal Cholom or Cymbal Dance).__
 
• __It is mostly performed by **men **who sing and dance to the beat of **Pung **while using **cymbals**, white **Pheijom **(Dhoti), and round turbans (Mridanga).__
 
• __The** Khamba Thoibi **dance, which is a male-female duet performance, is another significant aspect of **Manipuri **dance.__
 
• __Together with the **Maibi **Dance (Priestess Dance), **Leima** **Jagoi**, etc. from the** "Laiharaoba" dance**, there is the **Khamba **Thoibi dance.__
